text.en: Clients consistently praise trainer Nicko for his approachable demeanor, patience, and ability to keep dog owners motivated. Pet parents appreciate that he trains both humans and canines with kindness, never making handlers feel self-conscious during challenging moments. Reviewers describe him as a supportive mentor who genuinely bonds with dogs.

Dog owners report remarkable improvements in leash reactivity, excessive barking, and impulse control within just a few private sessions. Clients highlight that older rescue dogs and timid puppies alike gain lasting confidence through structured exposure exercises. Reviewers appreciate practical techniques that make daily walks calm and enjoyable.

Pet owners highlight the clear progression and detailed written summaries that Nicko sends following each private training session. Handlers value having practical homework exercises and training notes to practice between visits. Reviewers also appreciate his availability to answer questions and explain canine body language during consultations.

q.en: Does KRU Dog Training offer in-home private lessons?

a.en: Yes, clients highlight the convenience of one-on-one sessions conducted at home and in local neighbourhood parks.

q.en: Can older or reactive rescue dogs benefit from the training?

a.en: Yes, reviewers successfully addressed severe leash reactivity, barking, and fear in both senior rescues and young puppies.

q.en: What materials do dog owners receive after sessions?

a.en: The trainer provides weekly written recap summaries and structured homework exercises to support practice between lessons.

q.en: Are training techniques tailored to individual pet temperaments?

a.en: Yes, clients emphasize that exercises are customized around each dog's specific motivations, fears, and learning pace.
